europe_now.title: Ukraine conflict escalates with deadly Russian strikes on civilian targets
europe_now.summary: Deadly Russian strikes on civilian targets have escalated the conflict in Ukraine, with civilian deaths reaching the highest level since 2022. Ukraine's President Zelensky has requested additional Patriot interceptors to defend against the escalating attacks.

sources.headline: Ukraine: Zelensky asks for more Patriot interceptors as civilian deaths hit highest level since 2022

europe_now.title: European research funding shortfall threatens scientific sovereignty
europe_now.summary: A shortfall in research funding is threatening Europe's scientific sovereignty and independence. Funding denials under political pressure have raised concerns about the future of scientific research and collaboration in the region.

sources.headline: Carl Wunsch, oceanographer: ‘The consequences of Trump are terrible. Funding is denied because, apparently, all of our research is a hoax’

top_stories.title: Eastern Mediterranean energy dynamics shift with Egypt and Turkey's gains
top_stories.summary: Shifting energy dynamics in the Eastern Mediterranean are positioning Egypt and Turkey as significant regional beneficiaries. These developments are altering geopolitical alliances and energy security strategies across Southern Europe and the Middle East.

sources.headline: The new energy war in the Eastern Mediterranean (and why Egypt and Turkey stand to gain)

top_stories.title: Macron hosts Saudi Crown Prince MBS for Paris visit
top_stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron is hosting Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman for a two-day visit in Paris. The high-profile meeting covers a range of bilateral and regional issues, including energy cooperation, esports, and Middle Eastern geopolitics.

sources.headline: Macron hosts Saudi Crown Prince MBS for two-day Paris visit

top_stories.title: South Korea tests Arctic shipping route to Europe
top_stories.summary: South Korea has successfully tested a new Arctic shipping route by sending a container ship directly to Europe. This pilot route represents a potential shift in global logistics and trade corridors between Asia and Europe.

sources.headline: South Korea tests Arctic route with a first container shipped to Europe
